definitions.explanation: A young dog, typically less than one year old.

examples.japanese: {子犬|こいぬ}がしっぽを{振|ふ}っている。
examples.english: The puppy is wagging its tail.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{家|いえ}で{子犬|こいぬ}が{生|う}まれたので、{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: Puppies were born at the neighbor's house, so I went to see them.

examples.japanese: ペットショップで{見|み}た{子犬|こいぬ}がかわいくて、つい{飼|か}いたくなってしまった。
examples.english: The puppy I saw at the pet shop was so cute that I couldn't help wanting to keep it.

notes:
{子犬|こいぬ} refers to a young dog, typically under one year old. It is formed from {子|こ} (child, young) + {犬|いぬ} (dog), following a productive pattern used for other young animals: {子猫|こねこ} (kitten), {子馬|こうま} (foal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子犬|こいぬ}を{飼|か}う: to keep/raise a puppy
- {子犬|こいぬ}を{拾|ひろ}う: to find/pick up a stray puppy
- {子犬|こいぬ}が{生|う}まれる: puppies are born

COUNTER: {匹|ひき} (for small animals).
